title: Eclipse: show before you talk
goal: The owner sees their business working and asks for a plan.
audience: Small business owners in Mar del Plata, starting with real estate agencies.

mail.name: The opening email
mail.msg: An opening built on a concrete need: the enquiries that arrive after hours, put in order in a short demo.
mail.rule: Batches of 5 to 10 prospects, one variable per batch: a signal at 2 days and a close at 7.
mail.watch: Replies per batch, logged in the CRM

p.subj: A short demo for your agency
p.m: The enquiries that arrive after hours can be put in order too: we built a short demo to show you how.

mail.alt: Sample opening email with the See the demo button

call.name: The call
call.msg: «Am I speaking with whoever decides how new enquiries are handled? It takes 30 seconds to tell you why I'm calling.»
call.rule: The decision maker first; thirty seconds to say why the call, and the demo after.

p.m: Am I speaking with whoever decides how new enquiries are handled?

call.alt: Sample call screen with the first sentence

visit.name: The visit
visit.msg: «I dropped by to show you a demo of how an agency puts its enquiries in order; if now is a bad time, we set another.»
visit.rule: The demo on the phone, in hand; if it is a bad time, another day is booked.
visit.watch: Meetings booked during the visit itself

p.h: I dropped by to show you a demo

visit.alt: Sample sheet that comes with the visit, with the three steps

demo.name: The demo of their trade
demo.msg: «Which business do you want to power up?»: they pick their trade and see their business working, guided or on their own.
demo.rule: The first action of every plan is to see the demo, with a fictional business labelled «Demo».
demo.watch: The selector_chosen and demo_opened signals, with their trade

p.h: Which business do you want to power up?

demo.alt: Sample trade selector with the See it guided button

wa.name: WhatsApp with the plan
wa.msg: «Ask for this plan» opens WhatsApp with the chosen plan already written in the message.
wa.rule: A person replies and logs it in the CRM; the system works out the reminders and a person sends them.
wa.watch: whatsapp_opened, with its origin and its plan

p.q: Hi, I'd like the Growth plan.
m: Hi! I'll show you the demo for your trade and we'll put the proposal together.

wa.alt: Sample chat that opens with the chosen plan

proposal.name: The written proposal
proposal.msg: They replied: a call the same day and a proposal broken down piece by piece within 24 hours.
proposal.rule: Touches at 2, 5 and 9 days; archived at 14 and reactivated at 60.
proposal.watch: The proposal_sent activity in the CRM

p.m: What it includes, the maintenance and the date it is valid until.

proposal.alt: Sample email with the itemised proposal

paid.name: The cleared payment
paid.msg: The project starts with the first payment cleared at the bank.
paid.rule: A receipt announces it; the payment counts once it is verified and marked collected.
paid.alt: Sample receipt with the status collected

box.name: The welcome box
box.msg: «Your business, in full light»: it arrives with the start and opens the project's portal.
box.rule: Inside, the access to the portal and the project's five stages, from preparation to delivery.
box.watch: The client's first sign-in to the portal
box.alt: Sample welcome box with the eclipse on its lid

rules: First the demo, then the conversation.
Every demo says «Demo» and uses a fictional business.
A click is a signal; the cleared payment is the start.
next: Measuring the site's signals with an analytics provider, with events free of personal data.
source: The opening, the cadence and the funnel are in Eclipse's documents; the demo and WhatsApp, in its code. The box is the playbook's proposal.
